concerns.text: Task T001 (Quickstart – minimal end‑to‑end sanity check) is placed before the producer tasks (T002‑T005) that create the pipeline inputs it needs. It attempts to run the full pipeline on a tiny sample, which depends on data ingestion, filtering, LLM generation, and validation that have not yet been produced. This violates the foundational‑tasks‑first principle and creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering error.
